working_definition: Author type 'TmY3' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY3 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'TmY3' is FBbt:00003820 'transmedullary Y neuron TmY3'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052337 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y neuron that terminates with bleb-type arborizations in lobula layers 4 and lobula plate layer 4. It displays fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M2, M4, M5, M6, M8, and M10, and has bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M5 and M10. It is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052337 'immature transmedullary Y neuron TmY3' (exact match).
